caption_L2L3: Thailand's budget dipped sharply into deficit in 2020. Thailand's massive deficit lasted two years. In the aftermath of Thailand's budget deficit, Thailand's budget balance did not recover significantly within the following five years. In the three years following Thailand's budget balance deficit, there was no increase in recovery after the initial rebound.
